## About
When the time comes to plan a funeral or choose a final resting place, you want to work with a team you can trust.Laurel Land Funeral Home & Laurel Land Memorial Parkboth offer a knowledge and compassion you can count on. Working together, the teams atLaurel Land Funeral Home & Laurel Land Memorial Parkare dedicated to celebrating every life in a very personal way.
## Our Dallas funeral home
Located in South Dallas, just east of I-35 and the Redbird community, our funeral home is spacious and comfortable. It sits on the grounds of Laurel Land Memorial Park. Having these sister locations of funeral home and cemetery allows you the convenience of making funeral and cemetery arrangements.
We have a 300-seat funeral chapel, as well as more intimate family rooms. Should you wish to host a catered event, we have a reception area and can handle the food and drinks for you.
At Laurel Land Funeral Home, we understand that losing a loved one is a difficult emotional experience, we also know that every life is unique and every family is different. Our team, like our community, is diverse and experienced with a variety of religious and ethnic traditions. That’s not to say, however, that we assume anything. We take the time to ask questions and learn about each individual before helping plan a service.
## We celebrate life
Whether you want a basic[cremation](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/cremation/planning-a-cremation), a[traditional funeral](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/memorial-services/planning-a-funeral/traditional-funeral)in our chapel, a coffee-and-cake reception, or a creative outdoor celebration of life, we take care of every detail. There are endless ways to[customize a memorial service](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/memorial-services/planning-a-celebration-of-life/celebration-of-life). A caring and compassionate celebrant visits with your family and helps you celebrate a life like no other.
## Laurel Land Memorial Park cemetery
The well-landscaped Laurel Land Memorial Park is a wonderful cemetery that spans 300 acres. The[cemetery](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/cemetery)offers many choices for memorialization. Whether you prefer in-ground interment, mausoleum entombment or a memorial choice specific to cremation, we have an option to suit you and your wishes.
## South Dallas cemetery with notable burials
Laurel Land Memorial Park is a sweeping cemetery in South Dallas, just east of I-35 and the Redbird community. This is the final resting place of a number of sports figures, politicians and musicians, including famed blues guitarist Stevie Ray Vaughan, who regularly draws loyal fans who pay their respects.
## Cemetery for all people
Laurel Land Memorial Park is a cemetery for everyone. Our Lady of Guadalupe garden honors the Catholic heritage of our Spanish community. We have a sizable Veterans Garden, which is graced by the largest Pearl Harbor memorial in the contiguous United States outside of a national cemetery.
## Beautiful cemetery grounds
The cemetery comprises more than 300 acres—160 beautifully landscaped developed acres and 140 undeveloped acres, which will serve future generations. From the moment you pass through our iron gates and stone entrance, you will feel comforted.
With winding walkways, carefully trimmed trees, water features and stone statues, the cemetery is an idyllic setting away from the hustle and bustle of the big city. Chapel Springs is an especially lovely section of the property. Mature trees shade a small pond bubbling with fountains. We also have a charming little chapel called The Little Old Church in the Valley. This quaint chapel was named after a song from the early 30s, fashioned after a drawing that appeared on the sheet music and now sits at the water’s edge.
## A range of burial options
Whatever your burial preference, Laurel Land Memorial Park offers many choices, including in-ground interment, indoor or outdoor mausoleum entombment or a memorial choice specific to cremation. The Trinity Monument Garden Estates allows for upright monument while other areas accommodate flat granite markers or bronze-on-granite memorials.
We invite you to see our cemetery property for yourself. You are welcome to visit Laurel Land Memorial Park at any time. If you would like a guided tour and more information about our services, please call us.
## Veterans and Memorial Day services
The teams at Laurel Land Funeral Home and Laurel Land Memorial Park are well-versed in[veterans services](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/veterans)and military honors. We offer special funeral pricing for veterans and dedicate several sections of Laurel Land Memorial Park to the burial of[military veterans](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/veterans/military-funeral-honors). The cemetery is also home to the largest Pearl Harbor memorial in the contiguous United States outside of a national cemetery.
Each May, our annual Memorial Day service honors men and women who died serving our country, as well as mothers who lost children in the line of duty. The event draws hundreds of visitors to the cemetery and includes guest speakers, a showcase of World War II memorabilia, and an Avenue of Flags. We also place a U.S. flag on every veteran’s grave, so that for the day, the cemetery is awash in red, white and blue.
## Contact us
You and your family’s comfort matters a great deal to us. Generations of families have depended on Laurel Land Funeral Home and Laurel Land Memorial Park in Dallas to provide personalized service and compassionate care. For more information, please call us.
## History
Located in South Dallas on the grounds of Laurel Land Memorial Park, Laurel Land Funeral Home was built in 1964. The cemetery and funeral home are among the larger properties of their kind in the entire Dallas-Fort Worth area.
Since 2014, Laurel Land Funeral Home and Laurel Land Memorial Park have been part of the Dignity Memorial® network, the largest group of funeral, burial, cremation and cemetery service providers in North America.

That's why we offer every family we serve a 100% service guarantee. Should any detail
of our service not meet the expectations as promised in our agreement, we’ll do everything

## Celebration of Life Planning
Our planners are celebration of life experts. We plan more celebrations each year than any other provider, and we know just what to do to create a uniquely beautiful and heartfelt tribute with attention to detail like no other.
##### Every family who entrusts us with their loved one’s service can expect an event that includes:
* ### Meaningful music
Families are surprised to learn that we can play any songs you’d like or a different playlist for every aspect of the celebration.
* ### Cherished memories
A curated display of photographs and personal items invites family and friends to remember special moments and defining details.
* ### A personalized message
We work with a celebrant, clergy member or officiant to craft a heartfelt message that reflects your loved one and uplifts guests.

A cemetery is a place of reverence, reflection, history and continuity. When you create a permanent memorial for a loved one, you’re doing more than laying that person to rest. You’re establishing a legacy that spans the past, present and future.

## Our Cemetery Property

### Custom Estates
A family who wants to stay together may reserve an area of the cemetery exclusively for their loved ones. We design that family’s estate to suit their personal preferences.
PRICING STARTING AT4,995
### Mausoleum
Some people are more comfortable with the idea of aboveground burial over in-ground burial. Mausoleums, whether private or community, indoors or outdoors, provide that alternative.
PRICING STARTING AT7,995
* [Private](#burial-Private)
* [Community](#burial-Community)
* [Indoor](#burial-Indoor)
* [Outdoor](#burial-Outdoor)
Private Mausoleums
#### A legacy that speaks volumes
A very personalized resting place, a private mausoleum conveys a sense of exclusivity and intimacy. It allows a family to have a dedicated burial place that reflects their heritage, values and individuality. It also ensures family members remain together even after death. Customizable in nearly every way, a private mausoleum is a distinguished legacy.
Community Mausoleums
#### A dignified aboveground memorial
Those who wish to create a lasting tribute to their loved ones in a shared space may choose a community mausoleum. An accessible aboveground option, community mausoleums typically house both burial crypts and cremation niches. They often incorporate architectural elements and can foster a sense of connection among families in a community.
Indoor Mausoleums
#### A personalized, protected tribute
Some may value the protection indoor mausoleums provide. They may also appreciate that many indoor mausoleums are climate controlled for year-round comfort. This may be especially important in areas with harsh winters or intense heat. Indoor mausoleum may include spaces for committal services or places for visitors to sit and remember loved ones.
Outdoor Mausoleums
#### A garden setting for memorialization
Open-air mausoleums set among trees and landscaped lawns may appeal to those who find solace in nature. Without a defined walk-in area, garden mausoleums, as outdoor mausoleums are also known, blend in with the environment. Visitors simply walk right up to a loved one’s crypt or niche. Outdoor mausoleum spaces may cost less than those indoors.
### Ground Burial
The time-honored practice of traditional ground burial holds deep cultural and emotional significance for many families. There are ground burial options for both caskets and urns.
PRICING STARTING AT3,495
* ![Tiered hedge estates with beautiful landscaping at Rose Hills. ]()
#### Casket burial
Casket burial is an enduring tradition with a long history reflecting reverence and the desire for a dignified final resting place for a loved one. Those who choose casket burial for themselves may do so for cultural, religious or personal reasons.
* ![A cremation urn sits on a concrete garden bench with flowers]()
#### Urn burial
More and more people are choosing cremation. Just as a casket can be buried in the ground, so can an urn. Some cemeteries have cremation burial gardens. Some families choose to mix casket burial and urn burial in a single estate.
* ![markers and monuments]()
#### Markers and monuments
When you choose a grave marker, you’re creating a lasting legacy for friends and family to visit for generations to come. Crafted from granite or bronze, monuments and markers can be personalized to tell the stories of unique lives.
### Columbaria
Columbaria house banks of niches for urns. Large or small, private or public, indoors or outdoors, the structures are popular alternatives to cremation burial.
PRICING STARTING AT3,495
* [Indoor](#cremation-Indoor)
* [Outdoor](#cremation-Outdoor)
* [Glass-front niches](#cremation-Glass-frontniches)
Indoor
#### A sheltered cremation memorial
Whether standalone building or a room inside another building, an indoor columbarium houses cremation niches. Families may appreciate that many indoor columbaria are climate controlled for comfort, which may be important in areas with harsh weather. Indoor columbaria may include spaces for committal services or places for visitors to sit and reflect.
Outdoor
#### A garden setting for cremation urns
Banks of granite-front or bronze-front cremation niches can be found in community settings or as part of private estates. A columbarium may be part of a cremation garden or simply a standalone structure in another part of a cemetery. These dignified resting places with a connection to nature may hold hundreds of urns or that of a single individual.
Glass-front niche
#### A personalized urn display and more
There are three kinds of cremation niches: bronze front, granite front and glass front. All three can be customized as celebrations of life, but only a glass-front niche allows for the display of personal treasures. Families love glass-front niches because they can see a loved one’s urn as well as a few small reminders of that person whenever they visit.
### Cremation Gardens
Many cemeteries set aside areas for cremation memorials. These cremation gardens may simply be lawn space for burying urns or scattering ashes, or they may be thoughtfully landscaped miniparks.
PRICING STARTING AT2,995
![A custom butterfly cremation pedestal at Chapel Hill Gardens South Cemetery.]()
Cremation Pedestals
#### A monument that sparks memories
Cremation pedestals are small monuments that honor loved ones in personalized ways. Some hold urns; others simply mark burials or scatterings. Common in cremation gardens, slanted niche pedestals appeal to individuals who prefer simpler memorials. Some may choose larger pedestals with custom granite toppers, such as an angel or a guitar.
![Cremation Memorial]()
Cremation Benches
#### An invitation to pause and reflect
Cremation benches memorialize loved ones in much the same way as headstones. Crafted from granite and personalized for those being honored, they may hold as many as four urns or simply mark the places where urns were buried or ashes were scattered. Cremation benches invite cemetery visitors to sit a minute, visit loved ones and reflect.
![A Dignity Memorial associate looks at a gentlemen as he talks and they walk through the cemetery with trees.]()

## About

When the time comes to plan a funeral or choose a final resting place, you want to work with a team you can trust. Laurel Land Funeral Home & Laurel Land Memorial Park both offer a knowledge and compassion you can count on. Working together, the teams at Laurel Land Funeral Home & Laurel Land Memorial Park are dedicated to celebrating every life in a very personal way.

## Our Dallas funeral home

Located in South Dallas, just east of I-35 and the Redbird community, our funeral home is spacious and comfortable. It sits on the grounds of Laurel Land Memorial Park. Having these sister locations of funeral home and cemetery allows you the convenience of making funeral and cemetery arrangements.

We have a 300-seat funeral chapel, as well as more intimate family rooms. Should you wish to host a catered event, we have a reception area and can handle the food and drinks for you.

At Laurel Land Funeral Home, we understand that losing a loved one is a difficult emotional experience, we also know that every life is unique and every family is different. Our team, like our community, is diverse and experienced with a variety of religious and ethnic traditions. That’s not to say, however, that we assume anything. We take the time to ask questions and learn about each individual before helping plan a service.

## We celebrate life

Whether you want a basic cremation, a traditional funeral in our chapel, a coffee-and-cake reception, or a creative outdoor celebration of life, we take care of every detail. There are endless ways to customize a memorial service. A caring and compassionate celebrant visits with your family and helps you celebrate a life like no other.

## Laurel Land Memorial Park cemetery

The well-landscaped Laurel Land Memorial Park is a wonderful cemetery that spans 300 acres. The cemetery offers many choices for memorialization. Whether you prefer in-ground interment, mausoleum entombment or a memorial choice specific to cremation, we have an option to suit you and your wishes.

## South Dallas cemetery with notable burials

Laurel Land Memorial Park is a sweeping cemetery in South Dallas, just east of I-35 and the Redbird community. This is the final resting place of a number of sports figures, politicians and musicians, including famed blues guitarist Stevie Ray Vaughan, who regularly draws loyal fans who pay their respects.

## Cemetery for all people

Laurel Land Memorial Park is a cemetery for everyone. Our Lady of Guadalupe garden honors the Catholic heritage of our Spanish community. We have a sizable Veterans Garden, which is graced by the largest Pearl Harbor memorial in the contiguous United States outside of a national cemetery.

## Beautiful cemetery grounds

The cemetery comprises more than 300 acres—160 beautifully landscaped developed acres and 140 undeveloped acres, which will serve future generations. From the moment you pass through our iron gates and stone entrance, you will feel comforted.

With winding walkways, carefully trimmed trees, water features and stone statues, the cemetery is an idyllic setting away from the hustle and bustle of the big city. Chapel Springs is an especially lovely section of the property. Mature trees shade a small pond bubbling with fountains. We also have a charming little chapel called The Little Old Church in the Valley. This quaint chapel was named after a song from the early 30s, fashioned after a drawing that appeared on the sheet music and now sits at the water’s edge.

## A range of burial options

Whatever your burial preference, Laurel Land Memorial Park offers many choices, including in-ground interment, indoor or outdoor mausoleum entombment or a memorial choice specific to cremation. The Trinity Monument Garden Estates allows for upright monument while other areas accommodate flat granite markers or bronze-on-granite memorials.

We invite you to see our cemetery property for yourself. You are welcome to visit Laurel Land Memorial Park at any time. If you would like a guided tour and more information about our services, please call us.

## Veterans and Memorial Day services

The teams at Laurel Land Funeral Home and Laurel Land Memorial Park are well-versed in veterans services and military honors. We offer special funeral pricing for veterans and dedicate several sections of Laurel Land Memorial Park to the burial of military veterans. The cemetery is also home to the largest Pearl Harbor memorial in the contiguous United States outside of a national cemetery.

Each May, our annual Memorial Day service honors men and women who died serving our country, as well as mothers who lost children in the line of duty. The event draws hundreds of visitors to the cemetery and includes guest speakers, a showcase of World War II memorabilia, and an Avenue of Flags. We also place a U.S. flag on every veteran’s grave, so that for the day, the cemetery is awash in red, white and blue.

## Contact us

You and your family’s comfort matters a great deal to us. Generations of families have depended on Laurel Land Funeral Home and Laurel Land Memorial Park in Dallas to provide personalized service and compassionate care. For more information, please call us.

## History

Located in South Dallas on the grounds of Laurel Land Memorial Park, Laurel Land Funeral Home was built in 1964. The cemetery and funeral home are among the larger properties of their kind in the entire Dallas-Fort Worth area.

Since 2014, Laurel Land Funeral Home and Laurel Land Memorial Park have been part of the Dignity Memorial® network, the largest group of funeral, burial, cremation and cemetery service providers in North America.
